description: Use this when someone asks who owns a listed company, its largest shareholders, how much institutions or funds hold, how concentrated ownership is, or who bought or sold in the latest reports. Give it the ticker or name; optionally holder_type (institutions, funds, or local for the holders named in the register of the company's home market) and changes (new, increased, decreased, exited). Returns the largest holders with shares, percent of the company where 6ix can measure it, the change since their previous report, the date each position is as of, each holder's 6ix page and the filing, plus the company's Shareholders page and what 6ix reads for its market.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

group_by.description: family = one row per manager family (Vanguard once, not its ten filers)

holder_type.description: local = holders named in the register of the company's home market (Taiwan, the Netherlands, Brazil, Germany, Switzerland, Hong Kong, Spain)

period.description: Quarter end (YYYY-MM-DD); default the newest complete quarter. A quarter 6ix holds no reports for answers so, with the quarters it has

name: get_company_ownership

noReports.description: true when 6ix holds no institutions' reports for the quarter asked for (not a sign that nobody holds the company)

quarters.description: When a quarter was asked for: the quarter ends 6ix holds institutions' quarterly reports for, for this company, newest first

complete.description: false while that quarter's reports are still coming in

title: Who owns a company
